mapper.insert: insert into sys_plant (comp_cd, plant_cd, plant_nm, addr, time_zone, sort_no, use_yn, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.plantNm}, #{f.addr}, #{f.timeZone}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: select count(*) from mst_equip_hier where plant_cd = #{plantCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.sql: n.node_id, n.plant_cd, n.parent_id, n.node_type, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, n.sort_no, n.use_yn, n.remark, n.row_ver, n.updated_at, n.updated_by
mapper.select: with recursive t as ( select n.node_id, 1 as lvl, (n.plant_cd || '/' || n.node_cd)::text as path, array[lpad(n.sort_no::text, 9, '0') || rpad(n.node_cd, 30)] as ord from mst_equip_hier n where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.parent_id is null and n.use_yn = 'Y' union all select n.node_id, t.lvl + 1, t.path || '/' || n.node_cd, t.ord || (lpad(n.sort_no::text, 9, '0') || rpad(n.node_cd, 30)) from t join mst_equip_hier n on n.parent_id = t.node_id where t.lvl < 20 and n.use_yn = 'Y' ) select , t.lvl, t.path, (select count(*) from mst_equip_hier c where c.parent_id = n.node_id) as child_cnt from t join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = t.node_id order by t.ord

insert into mst_equip_hier (comp_cd, plant_cd, parent_id, node_type, node_cd, node_nm, sort_no, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.plantCd}, #{f.parentId}, #{f.nodeType}, #{f.nodeCd}, #{f.nodeNm}, #{f.sortNo}, #{f.useYn}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning node_id
